lines: \paragraph{Exact sign-flip permutation test validation.} As an independent check on bootstrap significance for the small-sample 32B models, we run exact sign-flip permutation tests on all six 32B comparisons, enumerating all $2^n$ sign permutations ($2^{19}{=}524{,}288$ for QwQ-32B, $2^{20}{=}1{,}048{,}576$ for R1-32B).
